title: Ansel and the Tryouts
premise: Juniper Ashgrove has survived two years at Wrenfield Academy by being nobody: scholarship kid, quiet grades, closed locker. But when they find their late grandmother's recipe box full of spellwork instead of cooking instructions, Juniper discovers the academy's elite 'Tryouts'—a secret society that recruits students to wield inherited magic—and that Grandma Ash was its most powerful defector. Recruited against their will by charming captain Elias Vane, Juniper must master a power that feeds on identity itself, while falling for outcast teammate Sable Okafor, who knows what the Tryouts did to her brother. As the season's final game approaches and Headmaster Corliss moves to bind every Tryout to the academy's will, Juniper chooses to break the binding rather than claim the power waiting for them, exposing Corliss, freeing the Tryouts, and finally letting themselves be seen—by everyone, including Sable.
about_author: Jude Pemberton is a former boarding school scholarship student who writes about the kids who watch the ivy from below. They live in a drafty coastal town with an ill-tempered cat and a suspiciously organized spice rack.

chapters.title: Head Down
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. A day in the life of strategic invisibility at Wrenfield: dodging rich-kid hazing, acing a chemistry quiz no one congratulates them for, eating lunch in the library stacks. Emotional beat: loneliness disguised as safety.

chapters.title: The Recipe Box
chapters.summary: Juniper inherits their grandmother's belongings after the funeral and finds a tin recipe box where cards read less like food and more like incantations. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: grief sharpening into curiosity.

chapters.title: Card Number One
chapters.summary: Following a card on a dare to themselves, Juniper lights a candle that answers back. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: terror and wonder colliding—the first crack in their careful invisibility.

chapters.title: The Letter Under the Linoleum
chapters.summary: Juniper pries up grandma's old kitchen floor and finds a letter warning them never to let Wrenfield know what they are. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: dread; the academy suddenly feels like a trap.

chapters.title: Elias Vane Sees You
chapters.summary: Golden-boy Elias corners Juniper in the greenhouse, having felt the candle's ripple across campus. He offers friendship with strings shaped like a question mark. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: flattered, unsettled.

chapters.title: Sable in the Stacks
chapters.summary: Library outcast Sable Okafor catches Juniper researching 'Wrenfield traditions' and warns them off with a bitterness that has history behind it. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: instant friction, reluctant fascination.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: A wax-sealed envelope appears in Juniper's locker: an invitation to Tryouts. Grandma's letter burns in their pocket like a second heartbeat. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: the choice they were told never to make.

chapters.title: First Practice
chapters.summary: Juniper attends anyway—curiosity wins—and witnesses nine students move objects with intention alone under Elias's coaching. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: belonging offered like bait.

chapters.title: What Happened to Daniel Okafor
chapters.summary: Sable reveals her brother was a Tryout who came back from the final game hollow-eyed and memory-stripped, then vanished from school entirely. POV Sable. Emotional beat: grief weaponized into purpose.

chapters.title: Labels
chapters.summary: Tryout training begins: exercises that strip away self-description until only raw intent remains. Juniper is disturbingly good. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: power as seduction; identity as cost.

chapters.title: Detention with Corliss
chapters.summary: Headmaster Corliss summons Juniper for a friendly chat that is anything but, probing about their grandmother with too much precision. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: prey realizing it's being tracked.

chapters.title: Study Session
chapters.summary: Forced together by a shared project, Juniper and Sable argue their way into honesty over cold coffee. POV alternating. Emotional beat: the first real laugh either has had all term.

chapters.title: The Archive Room
chapters.summary: Sable shows Juniper her hidden cache of confiscated Tryout records; grandma Ash's name appears on a 1978 roster, then crossed out. POV Sable. Emotional beat: legacy reframed—grandma was a deserter, not a victim.

chapters.title: Ash's Defection
chapters.summary: A hidden journal reveals grandma fled the Tryouts after discovering the final game binds players to the academy's service. POV Juniper reading. Emotional beat: inheritance redefined as warning.

chapters.title: Midnight Scrimmage
chapters.summary: A night practice goes wrong when a binding drill nearly erases a first-year named Theo; Elias covers it up smoothly. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: hero worship curdling.

chapters.title: Almost
chapters.summary: After the scrimmage, Juniper and Sable almost kiss in the archive doorway, then retreat into argument. POV Sable. Emotional beat: want versus self-protection.

chapters.title: Corliss's Offer
chapters.summary: Corliss offers Juniper a full ride, a future, and a subtle threat: scholarship students who refuse opportunities have accidents. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: duty tightening like a collar.

chapters.title: Team Bonding
chapters.summary: Elias throws a party meant to cement loyalty; Juniper watches teammates perform happiness that doesn't reach their eyes. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: charisma exposed as control.

chapters.title: The Hollow Ones
chapters.summary: Juniper and Sable track down three former Tryouts working menial jobs in town—all smiling, all vacant. POV Sable. Emotional beat: horror made mundane.

chapters.title: Grandma's Counter-Spell
chapters.summary: In the journal, Ash left an unfinished counter-binding requiring 'a name freely given and freely kept.' Juniper starts decoding it. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: hope with a deadline.

chapters.title: Elias Confides
chapters.summary: Elias admits he's scared—he saw what the final game took from his older sister—but claims there's no way out once you're rostered. POV Elias. Emotional beat: villain and victim in one body.

chapters.title: Rostered
chapters.summary: Juniper's name appears on the official Tryout roster; refusing now means expulsion and worse. Sable offers to run away with them tonight. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: love against duty, first true test.

chapters.title: The Night Bus
chapters.summary: Juniper gets as far as the station before realizing fleeing leaves every other Tryout bound and Sable's brother unfound. They turn back. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: sacrifice chosen over escape.

chapters.title: Falling
chapters.summary: No more almost: Juniper and Sable finally kiss in the rain-soaked greenhouse, agreeing to fight the final game together. POV alternating. Emotional beat: joy claimed defiantly.

chapters.title: Training Montage of Secrets
chapters.summary: The pair secretly coach fellow Tryouts in resisting binding drills while publicly performing compliance. POV Sable. Emotional beat: conspiracy as community.

chapters.title: Theo Breaks
chapters.summary: Terrified Theo reports the resistance to Corliss to save himself. Two conspirators are 'withdrawn' overnight. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: betrayal and its terrible logic.

chapters.title: Interrogation
chapters.summary: Corliss isolates Juniper, revealing he knew Ash personally—and that he loved her, which makes her betrayal his religion. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: the antagonist humanized and more frightening for it.

chapters.title: Sable Taken Off the Board
chapters.summary: Sable is suspended on fabricated charges to keep her away from the final game. POV Sable. Emotional beat: rage refined into resolve.

chapters.title: Elias's Choice
chapters.summary: Juniper shows Elias the journal and the hollow ones' addresses; he wavers between sister, team, and conscience. POV Elias. Emotional beat: a door opening inside a locked man.

chapters.title: The Recipe Box Complete
chapters.summary: Juniper finishes decoding Ash's counter-spell: it needs every Tryout's freely given name spoken at once—during the game, on the field. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: plan crystallizing against impossible odds.

chapters.title: Last Practice Before Everything
chapters.summary: Final drills; Corliss watches from the stands like a farmer counting harvest. Quiet goodbyes are exchanged in glances. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: calm before catastrophe.

chapters.title: Game Day Morning
chapters.summary: Juniper wakes to find their recipe box stolen from their room—Corliss has Ash's counter-spell and plans to invert it. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: the floor dropping out.

chapters.title: Sable Returns
chapters.summary: Sable breaks suspension, smuggles herself into the stadium, and brings one thing Corliss doesn't know exists: Ash's original letter, which contains half the spell from memory. POV Sable. Emotional beat: love showing up when it counts.

chapters.title: Kickoff
chapters.summary: The final game begins—a sport that is visibly, horribly not just a sport—as binding sigils ignite beneath the field. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: dread in motion.

chapters.title: The Binding
chapters.summary: Corliss springs the inverted ritual mid-game; teammates drop smiling and empty one by one; Elias freezes, then shoves Juniper toward the center circle. POV Elias. Emotional beat: redemption purchased at price.

chapters.title: Names Freely Given
chapters.summary: Climax: Juniper speaks their own name first, refusing to be labeled or erased; Sable leads the crowd-side chorus; one by one the Tryouts give their names back, unraveling Corliss's binding. POV alternating. Emotional beat: identity as rebellion.

chapters.title: Corliss Undone
chapters.summary: The inverted spell rebounds; Corliss faces the accumulated weight of every name ever taken from him. The board arrives to find him quietly resigned. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: justice without gloating.

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: The hollow ones begin remembering; Daniel Okafor calls his sister from a payphone two towns over. Elias takes responsibility and transfers away. POV Sable. Emotional beat: grief beginning to heal.

chapters.title: Who to Be
chapters.summary: Juniper, offered leadership of a reformed Tryouts, declines—not out of fear but choice—and instead proposes the group become something accountable and open. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: power refused, self claimed.

chapters.title: The Last Card
chapters.summary: Epilogue: Juniper adds a new card to grandma's recipe box—simple, handwritten, addressed to whoever needs it next—and walks across campus hand in hand with Sable, head up, locker open. POV Juniper. Emotional beat: visibility as homecoming.
